engineOptions: The Cadillac Celestiq (/səˈlɛstɪk/ se-LESS-tick) is a battery electric liftback made by the Cadillac division of General Motors.[1] It is the brand's flagship sedan, replacing the Cadillac CT6.[1] Production commenced in 2024.[2]
Like the Cadillac Lyriq, an electric SUV which precedes it, the Celestiq uses GM's Ultium battery technology and BEV3 platform.[6][10]
